name: smwmusic-mega-man-battle-network-title-theme-stage-clear-mix
title: Mega Man Battle Network - Title Theme (Stage-Clear-Mix)
description:
Jack in!! MegaMan, Execute!

Did a short arrangement of the Mega Man Battle Network Main Theme as a "stage-clear-mix" (based off the version heard in Battle Network 2). Had the idea to turn the Battle Network theme into a stage clear theme, especially given how much of a really badass and heroic theme it is!!

Doing these jingles is fun sometimes!! 😄

Important:
There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. C# Minor (Battle Network 2 Pitch) [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. B Minor (Original Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ3. A# Minor (Custom Pitch)
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ4. E Minor (Battle Network 6 Pitch)

There are also customizable options for enabling & disabling the goal tape sound that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ1. Enables Goal SFX [turned on by default]
‎‎‎‎‎‎‎‎ㅤ2. Disables Goal SFX
